def f(x):
    x_view = np.array(x, copy=False)
    x_view[:] *= x_view # modify memory without telling mx
    return x.sum()

x = mx.array([3.0])
y, df = mx.value_and_grad(f)(x)

print("f'(x) = 2x !=", df.item()) # 1.0
```
